name: RestaurantReservationManager
tagline: Covers, table plan, turn times, waitlist and no-shows – a complete host-stand app for Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A full restaurant reservation module in one PCF control: service dashboard with pacing per slot and alerts, bookings list with bulk actions, live floor plan with drag-and-drop or tap-to-seat and auto-assign, timeline by table with clash detection, walk-in waitlist with wait estimates and table-ready messages, no-show and late-cancellation rules and guest history.
features: Covers per slot with pacing limit and manager override
Table plan from a simple text list (Name:Seats:Area)
Live table states – free, booked soon, seated with turn timer, overdue, blocked
Seat, assign or combine tables (M1+M2) with capacity and clash checks
Auto-assign tables for the whole service
Timeline by table with now line and clash outline
Walk-in waitlist with quoted vs actual wait and estimated table time
No-show grace period, late-cancellation flag, large-party deposit rule
Guest history (visits, no-shows, cancellations) across bookings
Guest messages: confirmation, table ready, running late, thank you
Undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts, phone layout with bottom navigation
